findings.summary: The recorded pre-commit checks ran before MERGE-RESOLUTION.md existed, not on tree f0a017e2: the verifier counted 1,704 documents and 6,776 local links against 1,705 and 6,779 on the commit, and the doctor saw 111 tracked modifications against 112 changed paths. This review's fresh checks on the exact commit pass. Bind A4 to checks of 5f30f26b/f0a017e2 and state which tree the earlier runs used.

Dropping the branch's stale P22 STATUS line is justified, but the stated reason is imprecise. REQUIREMENTS section P22 holds the line's substance, not its text; the text is in 6fb6525f:STATUS.md, and the delivery details are in the retained P22 records. Reword the row.

holds names 15 of the retained schema-1 file's 40 non-identity top-level keys. It omits previous_recovery, older_recoveries, pending_phase_delivery, p29_reconstruction, next_action, checkpoint and others, whereas main's own entry lists every key. The checker accepts it, and the listed p29_r07_superseded_fields_index indexes most omitted keys. List all keys, or say in purpose that holds is a selection.

The task record, which the merge leaves unchanged, still names execution_mode_record, historical_handoff, p31_macos_contract_design and p29_local_publication_r07 as current-state CURRENT.json fields. Schema-2 CURRENT no longer has them. Add a P32 fields index in the outcome update of the task record (A6).

On the branch, STATUS says 'No scope is selected' and gives C271 at bef67902 blocked at P29-PUBLICATION-SIZE-001, while CURRENT has C271 active at P32. CURRENT boundary 9 discloses this, and MAIN-CONFLICTS keeps main's dated entries until R04. No change in this merge; R04 must replace them.

Main's generated TRD index, correctly taken as main's bytes, does not list the branch's trd_c271-p29-exact-publication-in-local-mode_2026-11-25.md, which now sits beside it. MERGE-RESOLUTION does not carry forward MAIN-CONFLICTS' regeneration note. Record the note in P32's outcome and regenerate the index in a later commit.
